Set.Text: There are five paths to victory available to you in Civilization V:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Domination Victory[NEWLINE]Capture The Flag Victory[NEWLINE]Cultural Victory[NEWLINE]Diplomatic Victory[NEWLINE]2050 Arrives
2 free Great Scientists appear near the City where the Wonder was built.

There are six types of non-combat units: Settlers, Workers, Work Boats, Great People, Flag units, and Religious Units. Each is critically important to a civilization's success. As the name non-combat would suggest, these units cannot fight. If attacked by an enemy unit while alone in a hex they are automatically captured or destroyed. Therefore it usually makes sense to escort them with a military unit when sending them out into the wilderness.
An important technology it allows you to build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Missile Cruiser[ENDCOLOR], a Naval Unit capable of carrying 3 Missiles and spotting enemy Submarines.
Allows you to build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Rocket Artillery[ENDCOLOR] and [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Helicopter Gunship[ENDCOLOR] military units.

An important technology, Rocketry allows you to build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Apollo Program[ENDCOLOR]. Also allows you to build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Rocket Artillery[ENDCOLOR] military unit, and the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Mobile SAM[ENDCOLOR], a fast unit specialized in thwarting enemy aircraft.

Allows you to build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Nuclear Missile[ENDCOLOR], a frightening weapon that requires [ICON_RES_URANIUM] Uranium, and is capable of destroying units and cities. Also allows you to build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Guided Missile[ENDCOLOR], an inexpensive single-use Unit that can damage enemy Units.
